PROJECT DOSSIER / 02

Alchemists' Walpurgis Night

Overview


A card game where players take on the roles of demonic alchemists, combining Suffering cards in different proportions to create “Tragedies” (Tragödie) worth varying points. After the final round, each player totals the points of their Tragödie cards. The player closest to 13 points wins, while anyone exceeding 13 is immediately eliminated.
